notes: Master is the product population/identity source (SKU unique), Stock is the inventory quantity source; the output grain is one record per Master SKU.

Join Stock to Master on the composite key Company + Item code (both sheets expose it, 6 codes x 2 companies, one Stock row each); matching on Item code alone would cross companies and is forbidden by the operator requirement.
SKU is synthesized by the source as <Company>-<zero-padded Item code>; item codes are numeric-looking but must stay text so leading zeros survive.
Quantity pieces is already expressed in individual pieces; the contract gives no unit, pack-size or VAT facts and the file contains no price or tax columns, so none are inferred.
No source column carries a currency, VAT rate or pack size; none of the three target fields needs one.
Product name comes solely from Master.Description; Stock has no name column, so unmatched Stock rows cannot supply /product_name and would need a repair request rather than a fabricated name.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Master' is the product master: one row per product, SKU is unique across all 12 rows (TH-0001, MY-0003, ...), and Description holds the product name. Company + Item code is a second unique composite key that identifies the same product within a company, which is exactly what the Stock sheet references. This is the population and identity source required by /sku and /product_name.
